reason_for_exclusions: Screen remains exploratory. MOND and mond-screen are mapped duplicates of ptq-nu and ptq-screen.

families.roundoff_exception: none; stop if absolute identity fails

families.start_note: archived initial vector, not a signed-target MLE

families.roundoff_exception: reuse the existing D1R provisional 8 ULP rule for line-search trials only

shared_requirements: transactional checkpoint and independent fine192 replay
weak-field audit with c=299792.458 km/s; superluminal accepted states are not canonical
one endpoint quadrature refinement using a node count the existing nuisance routine already accepts; it is a precision diagnostic, not a new likelihood
stop if two consecutive accepted absolute objective changes are below 1e-4 while the projected infinity norm remains above 1e-3

classes.SINGLE_START_STATIONARITY: projected infinity norm <= 1e-4, strict identity, replay gap <= 1e-8, quadrature diagnostic recorded, accepted state subluminal
classes.CONDITIONAL: objective decreased and identity held, but the projected norm or the quadrature diagnostic misses the stationarity class
classes.FAIL: identity failure, nonfinite values, an accepted superluminal state, or no objective decrease
classes.not_an_mle: A single-start stationarity class is not a scientific MLE and is not a model ranking.
